limitations: Registered proof mode is operator opt-in, not automatically available as trusted attestation for every legacy client-owned tool.
Signed contract owner/project binding is not authenticated public multi-tenant IAM. Operator/verifier is trusted; HMAC does not make incorrect issuer facts true.
36 are contract fixtures; separate real-model canaries and three native tasks supply end-to-end evidence. They are not 36 unassisted native missions.
Vision/document/deploy negative contract fixtures do not certify every real OCR/GPU, document or deployment workload.
No model-weight training, absolute hallucination-free guarantee or universal numerical autonomy certification.
Unit rollback model passed; a production failure/reboot was not deliberately induced.
